SELECT 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr_fee)
FROM 
    web_sales ws
JOIN 
    web_returns wr ON (ws.ws_item_sk = wr.wr_item_sk AND ws.ws_order_number = wr.wr_order_number)
JOIN 
    web_page wp ON (ws.ws_web_page_sk = wp.wp_web_page_sk)
JOIN 
    customer_address ca ON (ca.ca_address_sk = wr.wr_refunded_addr_sk)
JOIN 
    date_dim dm ON (ws.ws_sold_date_sk = dm.d_date_sk)
JOIN 
    reason r ON (r.r_reason_sk = wr.wr_reason_sk)
JOIN 
    customer_demographics cd1 ON (cd1.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_refunded_cdemo_sk)
JOIN 
    customer_demographics cd2 ON (cd2.cd_demo_sk = wr.wr_returning_cdemo_sk)
WHERE 
    dm.d_year = 1998
    AND ca.ca_country = 'United States'
    AND (
        (ca.ca_state IN ('NC', 'TX', 'IA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 100.00 AND 200.00)
        OR (ca.ca_state IN ('WI', 'WV', 'GA') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 150.00 AND 300.00)
        OR (ca.ca_state IN ('OK', 'VA', 'KY') AND ws.ws_net_profit BETWEEN 50.00 AND 250.00)
    )
GROUP BY 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr_fee)
ORDER BY 
    SUBSTRING(r_reason_desc FROM 1 FOR 20),
    AVG(ws_quantity),
    AVG(wr_refunded_cash),
    AVG(wr_fee)
LIMIT 100
